use_case_name: Update the Facility Map and Displayed Devices

claims.content: The use case allows the System Administrator to modify the facility map layout and manage which devices are displayed on the GUI.

goal.raw_text: The use case allows the System Administrator to modify the facility map layout and manage which devices are displayed on the GUI.

claims.content: System Administrator
The System Administrator needs to update the facility map layout or modify which devices are displayed on the GUI.

trigger.raw_text: The System Administrator needs to update the facility map layout or modify which devices are displayed on the GUI.

claims.content: The System Administrator logs into the system and navigates to the configuration screen.
The GUI displays a layout of the mainline I-15, SR-163 freeway area in the same geographic area as the I-15 Reversible Lane.
The System Administrator selects the option to modify the facility map or device display settings.
The GUI allows devices to be added and removed from the display without requiring programming effort.
The System Administrator makes the desired changes to the map or device list.
The system updates the database tables with the new configuration.
The GUI reflects the changes immediately on the display for all users.
If the System Administrator attempts to add or remove a device that requires additional configuration, the system prompts for a login password specific to that action.
If the database update fails due to a conflict or error, the system notifies the administrator and rolls back the changes without updating the display.
If the System Administrator attempts to modify the facility map or device display without proper authorization (e.g., user account privileges), the system denies access to the configuration screen.

If the System Administrator attempts to add or remove a device from the display that requires additional configuration effort (as determined by the system rules), the GUI prompts for an additional login password specific to that action. If the correct password is not provided, the modification is aborted.

If the system encounters a database error or conflict while attempting to update the configuration tables with the new map or device settings, the transaction is rolled back. The system notifies the administrator of the failure, and the display remains unchanged.

If the communication link between the workstation and the server/database is lost during the update process, the system prevents the incomplete transaction from being saved and alerts the administrator to check the network connection.
The facility map layout is updated in the system database.
The set of devices displayed on the GUI reflects the changes made by the System Administrator.
All users viewing the GUI see the updated facility map and device display immediately.
The configuration option allows user accounts to be changed remotely in the field units if applicable to the scope of the update.
